extraction.name: SWE-rebench
extraction.description: A public dataset of over 21,000 interactive Python-based software engineering tasks mined from GitHub repositories using an automated pipeline, designed for reinforcement learning and decontaminated evaluation of software engineering agents.
extraction.creator: Ibragim Badertdinov, Alexander Golubev, Maksim Nekrashevich, Anton Shevtsov, Simon Karasik, Andrei Andriushchenko, Maria Trofimova, Daria Litvintseva, Boris Yangel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data collection extracted pull requests and linked issues from GitHub Archive and cloned GitHub repositories with full commit histories. Data was filtered to select pull requests from permissive-license Python repositories where Python constitutes over 75% of the codebase, the PR resolves a single issue, modifies between 1 and 15 files, and introduces or modifies tests alongside code changes.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Pull requests linked to issues created before May 1, 2025
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Candidates were filtered based on license, resolution status, single-issue linkage, issue text length (>10 characters), inclusion of test modifications, and file change limits (1 to 15 files). Candidate tasks were grouped by project versions from git tags. Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct generated candidate installation recipes. Setup was verified inside containers using Buildah on TractoAI, ensuring tests fail before applying the solution patch and pass afterward. Dependency versions were frozen via pip freeze and conda env export.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automated instance quality assessment using a fine-tuned Qwen 2.5-72B-Instruct model trained on annotations from SWE-bench Verified. The model evaluates each task instance independently across three binary quality dimensions: Issue Clarity, Task Complexity, and Test Patch Correctness, based on the issue description, solution patch, and test patch.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Model predictions were evaluated on a validation split of 413 instances from SWE-bench Verified. The fine-tuned model achieved 81% accuracy (weighted F1: 0.82) on Task Complexity, 67% accuracy (weighted F1: 0.65) on Test Patch Correctness, and 79% accuracy (weighted F1: 0.76) on Issue Clarity.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Continuous pipeline execution supplying fresh tasks; task creation timestamps are tracked against model release dates to maintain a decontaminated benchmark leaderboard.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Accelerating autonomous software engineering agents carries risks such as overreliance on AI-generated code or misuse for introducing vulnerabilities, which the authors aim to mitigate through transparent, decontaminated evaluation and open benchmarks.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Automated task quality assessment may leave some tasks imperfectly described or unsolvable solely from the issue description; initial release is exclusively limited to Python; automated installation recipe generation relies on heuristics and LLM interpretation which may fail on complex or custom environments.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training (specifically reinforcement learning) and benchmarking/evaluation of LLM-based software engineering agents.
